digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and verifier routing
propositions: Three independent code paths select the verifier model and all break off the configured default provider when a non-default model id is supplied, causing silent downgrades and provider mismatches.
resolve_model does not call resolve_model_string, so workflow YAML declaring model: standard passes the literal string rather than resolving the class to its configured model id.

code-review.yaml's verify step declares no model key at all, causing it to fall through to cfg.model (frontier) instead of respecting the configured standard class, even though temperature: 0 is set for determinism only on the standard model.

The verifier path resolution via equality test (cfg.model == DEFAULT_MODEL) is defeated by provider-qualified model ids (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) that name the same underlying model but fail string comparison, leaving the verifier on the frontier.

Five separate call sites consume or compute model_ladder[0] and model class resolution independently, creating a split-brain where the same verifier configuration choice is implemented inconsistently across plan-review, completion, code-review, and batch runners.
